data.title: Upload
data.tagline: Send a file from a device to the website
data.description: Uploading includes choosing, transferring, and saving a file. Explain type, size, and count limits before selection, show progress during transfer, and allow retry after failure. The server still needs to check the file and the user's permission.

distinctions.label: File item
distinctions.explanation: Upload handles choosing, transferring, and retrying a file. File displays a file that already exists or is being processed.

avoid: Reveal limits only after a long upload fails
Show no progress for a large file
Trust the filename or browser check as final validation
Remove a failed file without offering a retry

lessonPractice.title: People can upload avatars up to 20 MB, and a network interruption must be recoverable. Which flow is most complete?

options.label: Check the format in the browser and then treat the file as safe
options.feedback: Browser checks improve feedback but can be bypassed. The server must still verify type, size, and permission.

options.label: Explain limits before selection, show progress, and allow retry after failure
options.feedback: People can choose an eligible file, see the transfer state, and recover from failure while the server validates it again.

options.label: Accept every file first and report an invalid size only after transfer
options.feedback: Final server validation is still required, but known limits should be visible before a long transfer begins.

data.agentPrompt: Improve avatar upload: state the allowed formats and 20 MB limit before selection, show progress, allow retry, and validate again on the server before saving. Test an oversized file, a successful upload, and a network interruption.
